summary: v0.2 treats the proposal as a reversible public protocol inside provisional geometry. Scores indicate residual risk before authorized pilot delivery, not probability or approval.

register_contract.score_meaning: 1=low residual concern after current controls; 5=high unresolved residual concern before an authorized pilot
register_contract.default_rule: uncertain authority, missing evidence or an unresolved red card keeps the affected interface on hold

dimensions.label: 数据隐私
dimensions.note: Public-facing AI could over-collect location, voice, accessibility or service-request data.
dimensions.mitigation: Each interface declares minimum inputs, forbidden data, retention, non-AI parity and automatic expiry; synthetic fixtures are the default.
dimensions.human_review: Data-protection role and affected-group steward both sign before limited pilot; either may pause and require deletion evidence.
dimensions.trigger: collection exceeds the declared minimum, forbidden data appears, or deletion evidence is absent
dimensions.prevention: Each interface declares minimum inputs, forbidden data, retention, non-AI parity and automatic expiry; synthetic fixtures are the default.
dimensions.human_signoff: Data-protection role and affected-group steward both sign before limited pilot; either may pause and require deletion evidence.
dimensions.appeal_path: in-person, phone and paper intake; independent human written outcome; no service penalty for refusing AI
dimensions.hold_rule: trigger or unresolved red card immediately moves linked interfaces to hold; human service parity stays available
dimensions.resume_gate: scoped data deleted; incident reviewed; revised data card and synthetic fixture pass
dimensions.retention: appeal/deletion records: declared case window plus 90-day non-personal audit log
dimensions.residual_risk: re-identification and operational leakage remain possible until an independent data review

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: Ownership, heritage, rail, traffic, utilities, fire and multi-role coordination are unresolved.
dimensions.mitigation: Gate 0 blocks physical delivery; P1 uses three small reversible pads, role-based RACI and explicit permission dependencies.
dimensions.human_review: Authorized sponsor plus relevant planning, heritage, traffic, fire, accessibility and utility professionals decide entry to each phase.
dimensions.trigger: any ownership, heritage, rail, traffic, utility, fire, accessibility or operating permission is missing
dimensions.prevention: Gate 0 blocks physical delivery; P1 uses three small reversible pads, role-based RACI and explicit permission dependencies.
dimensions.human_signoff: Authorized sponsor plus relevant planning, heritage, traffic, fire, accessibility and utility professionals decide entry to each phase.
dimensions.appeal_path: in-person, phone and paper intake; independent human written outcome; no service penalty for refusing AI
dimensions.hold_rule: trigger or unresolved red card immediately moves linked interfaces to hold; human service parity stays available
dimensions.resume_gate: all Gate 0 dependencies signed by authorized roles; reversible method and safe removal verified
dimensions.retention: permission and phase-decision record retained for the project lifecycle
dimensions.residual_risk: multi-party delay and interface conflict remain high without an authorized sponsor

dimensions.label: 公众接受度
dimensions.note: AI branding may crowd out daily life or create surveillance and technology-exclusion concerns.
dimensions.mitigation: Free threshold space, non-AI route, quiet hours, no facial recognition, public change log and independent appeal are mandatory.
dimensions.human_review: Three affected-group steward seats hold a red-card pause and verify that feedback changes the protocol or spatial component.
dimensions.trigger: surveillance concern, daily-use displacement, repeated complaint or an affected-group red card
dimensions.prevention: Free threshold space, non-AI route, quiet hours, no facial recognition, public change log and independent appeal are mandatory.
dimensions.human_signoff: Three affected-group steward seats hold a red-card pause and verify that feedback changes the protocol or spatial component.
dimensions.appeal_path: in-person, phone and paper intake; independent human written outcome; no service penalty for refusing AI
dimensions.hold_rule: trigger or unresolved red card immediately moves linked interfaces to hold; human service parity stays available
dimensions.resume_gate: written response published; harmed service restored; steward confirms protocol or spatial change
dimensions.retention: complaint and response record retained 12 months without unnecessary personal content
dimensions.residual_risk: technology symbolism may still create distrust even when service controls pass

dimensions.label: 运维成本
dimensions.note: Staffing, accessibility support, audit, maintenance, compute energy and insurance lack committed funding.
dimensions.mitigation: Projects use resource bands, low-power mock interfaces, expiry-by-default and an operations reserve gate; unfunded services do not launch.
dimensions.human_review: Future sponsor, operator, public steward and finance/procurement roles review total lifecycle resources before renewal.
dimensions.trigger: staffing, maintenance, accessibility support, audit, insurance or energy reserve is unfunded
dimensions.prevention: Projects use resource bands, low-power mock interfaces, expiry-by-default and an operations reserve gate; unfunded services do not launch.
dimensions.human_signoff: Future sponsor, operator, public steward and finance/procurement roles review total lifecycle resources before renewal.
dimensions.appeal_path: in-person, phone and paper intake; independent human written outcome; no service penalty for refusing AI
dimensions.hold_rule: trigger or unresolved red card immediately moves linked interfaces to hold; human service parity stays available
dimensions.resume_gate: lifecycle resource envelope, reserve and responsible operator confirmed; unfunded interface remains closed
dimensions.retention: resource decision and renewal record retained for each 90-day cycle
dimensions.residual_risk: resource bands are not budgets and cost escalation remains unmeasured

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性
dimensions.note: No statutory planning control, data authorization or implementing mandate is established by this submission.
dimensions.mitigation: All controls remain unknown or provisional; passport states never bypass approval, procurement, data or professional review.
dimensions.human_review: Only authorized government and professional processes can approve controls or field operations; the Agent cannot promote status.
dimensions.trigger: a concept passport is represented as approval, or law/policy/mandate changes
dimensions.prevention: All controls remain unknown or provisional; passport states never bypass approval, procurement, data or professional review.
dimensions.human_signoff: Only authorized government and professional processes can approve controls or field operations; the Agent cannot promote status.
dimensions.appeal_path: in-person, phone and paper intake; independent human written outcome; no service penalty for refusing AI
dimensions.hold_rule: trigger or unresolved red card immediately moves linked interfaces to hold; human service parity stays available
dimensions.resume_gate: claim corrected; applicable professional and authority reviews completed; public status label refreshed
dimensions.retention: approval, version and correction records retained under the authorized records policy
dimensions.residual_risk: future policy interpretation and procurement requirements remain outside Agent control

dimensions.label: 空间争议
dimensions.note: Provisional polygons and unknown ownership may conflict with actual parcels, protected areas or daily community use.
dimensions.mitigation: Every design feature is normalized, reversible and re-computable; official polygons and surveys invalidate derived placement.
dimensions.human_review: Survey, ownership, heritage, landscape and community-access reviews precede any location decision.
dimensions.trigger: official geometry, survey, title, protection or daily-use evidence conflicts with a generated feature
dimensions.prevention: Every design feature is normalized, reversible and re-computable; official polygons and surveys invalidate derived placement.
dimensions.human_signoff: Survey, ownership, heritage, landscape and community-access reviews precede any location decision.
dimensions.appeal_path: in-person, phone and paper intake; independent human written outcome; no service penalty for refusing AI
dimensions.hold_rule: trigger or unresolved red card immediately moves linked interfaces to hold; human service parity stays available
dimensions.resume_gate: all derived geometry recomputed; conflict logged; affected users and authorized professionals sign location decision
dimensions.retention: source geometry, change log and decision retained for the design lifecycle
dimensions.residual_risk: provisional placement cannot predict parcel, asset or community-use conflict

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: Synthetic protocol checks do not prove model accuracy, field safety, accessibility or reliability.
dimensions.mitigation: State progression is concept → simulation → sandbox → limited → hold/retire; model/version change forces retest.
dimensions.human_review: Assurance role verifies fixtures; service professional makes the decision; public steward can pause at any state.
dimensions.trigger: model/version changes, fixture fails, unexplained high-risk output or field reliability falls below a declared gate
dimensions.prevention: State progression is concept → simulation → sandbox → limited → hold/retire; model/version change forces retest.
dimensions.human_signoff: Assurance role verifies fixtures; service professional makes the decision; public steward can pause at any state.
dimensions.appeal_path: in-person, phone and paper intake; independent human written outcome; no service penalty for refusing AI
dimensions.hold_rule: trigger or unresolved red card immediately moves linked interfaces to hold; human service parity stays available
dimensions.resume_gate: affected version invalidated; all required fixtures rerun; service professional and public steward approve limited restart
dimensions.retention: fixture input/output hashes and non-personal change log retained for the declared version
dimensions.residual_risk: synthetic checks do not establish field accuracy, reliability or safety

dimensions.label: 公平与包容性
dimensions.note: Digital-only services, rent pressure, inaccessible interfaces or event capture could exclude residents and small operators.
dimensions.mitigation: Non-AI parity, free public threshold, affordable-space covenant, no-displacement trigger, accessible co-testing and benefit ledger are required.
dimensions.human_review: Affected-group stewards, accessibility reviewer and independent appeal role review distributional impact at 30/60/90 days.
dimensions.trigger: non-AI service is slower or worse, an interface is inaccessible, displacement/rent pressure appears, or benefits concentrate
dimensions.prevention: Non-AI parity, free public threshold, affordable-space covenant, no-displacement trigger, accessible co-testing and benefit ledger are required.
dimensions.human_signoff: Affected-group stewards, accessibility reviewer and independent appeal role review distributional impact at 30/60/90 days.
dimensions.appeal_path: in-person, phone and paper intake; independent human written outcome; no service penalty for refusing AI
dimensions.hold_rule: trigger or unresolved red card immediately moves linked interfaces to hold; human service parity stays available
dimensions.resume_gate: parity restored and co-tested; distributional response and benefit ledger published; unresolved harm retires the interface
dimensions.retention: parity, accessibility, benefit and appeal records retained for each 30/60/90-day review
dimensions.residual_risk: affordability and displacement cannot be proven without field baselines and ongoing monitoring
